title: Conveyor Maintenance Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Conveyor Maintenance Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Preparation & LOTO-Unexpected startup
-Multiple energy sources		-Crush
-Entanglement
-Amputation		20 (VERY HIGH)-LOTO conveyor power source
-Disconnect and lock all drives
-Release belt tension
-Block against gravity on incline
2. Belt Inspection-Pinch points
-Moving parts
-Sharp edges
-Heat buildup		-Hand/finger injuries
-Cuts
-Burns		16 (HIGH)-Use belt breakers/pinch bars
-Keep hands away from rollers
-Inspect while stationary
-Check for hot bearings
3. Roller/ Pulley Replacement-Heavy components
-Pinch points
-Tools in motion		-Back strain
-Crush injuries
-Tool drops		12 (HIGH)-Use mechanical lifting aids
-Team lifting for heavy items
-Proper rigging techniques
-Secure tools with lanyards
-Stage replacement parts nearby
4. Belt Tensioning-Stored energy
-Spring forces
-Improper tools		-Whiplash
-Struck by components
-Eye injury		15 (HIGH)-Controlled tension release
-Use proper tensioning equipment
-Follow manufacturer specs
-Wear safety glasses
5. Testing & Restart-Unexpected startup
-Misalignment issues		-Crush
-Entanglement
-Equipment damage		10 (MEDIUM)-Remove all tools and materials
-Account for all personnel
-Remove LOTO devices
-Start at low speed
-Monitor for unusual sounds

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ High-Vis Vest ☐ Hearing Protection ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves

☐ Fall Protection (if elevated)
